fused: NOT RUN: conditions 1 and 2 do not both hold, and the router is a conjunction -- the verdict is fixed without it. It is mandatory before any authorisation and would have been run had they held.

row.title: D2-PRE -- closed-form preflight: does ANY new-row class carry residual capacity, and which?
row.registered: 2026-08-29, adopted from the Codex review of D2's registration, before any tokenizer was trained.
row.question: D2 costs five full B->A chains. Before spending them: do new rows contain useful residual capacity at all, and does NON-OVERLAPPING segmentation beat ADDITIVE OVERLAPPING rows at an equal row budget? Section 17b's fertility slope cannot answer either -- it is correlated headroom, so it motivates a diagnostic, not a training programme.
row.lever: NO TRAINING CHAINS. Every arm keeps R0's 30,522 incumbent rows FROZEN and adds exactly K = 35,014 rows (30,522 + 35,014 = 65,536, the 64K vocabulary D2's own row names). That overlay shape is FORCED by this row's own held_fixed ('frozen incumbent rows') and staged check 2 ('sum-initialize the new rows'): a wholesale vocabulary replacement has no incumbent rows to freeze and no constituents to sum-initialize from. D2 PROPER remains a full replacement; this is its preflight analogue. Four arms at EQUAL added-row budget: (a) D2 -- deterministic BPE learning exactly K adjacent-token merges over the incumbent post-preprocessing WordPiece stream, merges permitted across the whitespace boundary, special tokens excluded from mining, LEARNED MERGE RANKS applied at inference (not greedy longest-match), every new unit recursively expanded into incumbent rows for its sum init; (b) additive overlapping WORD n-gram rows; (c) additive overlapping CHARACTER n-gram rows; (d) arm (a) with a frozen cold-row fallback. Closed-form ridge residual solves on m8src/blockcg.py (B7: 17 s at 131,072 rows).
row.held_fixed: Teacher, document vectors, the pool, and every incumbent row. Only the added rows are solved for.
row.staged_checks: (1) OPPORTUNITY -- DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, AND IT MAY NOT STOP THE PROBE (amended, see amended_2 BLOCKER 1). Retokenize dev+train queries and report the fertility reduction under arm (a), using m8src/retention_decomp.py's definition. It is reported, never gated on: the '~0.104' threshold is 0.00519/0.050, which reads section 17b's association as a one-directional bound -- exactly what the D2 row's scope_limit forbids -- and it is a fertility test that could kill the additive arms, whose mechanisms (conjunction, rare-string coverage, denoising) need not reduce fertility at all. (2) COMPILE/FLOOR: sum-initialize arm (a)'s new rows, zero residual, score against R0 -- must reproduce it within 0.001 dense. The POOLING-MODEL CANARY is ALGEBRAIC, not a retrieval comparison (amended, BLOCKER 6): on real incumbent rows through the real serving rule, the sum init must be exact and the mean init must not, on fixtures carrying CONTEXT TOKENS (a phrase that is a query's only content normalizes sum and mean to the same vector, so a two-token fixture cannot fail -- CODEMAP pitfall 19). Mean-init retrieval is reported DESCRIPTIVELY beside it. (3) RESIDUAL: solve only the new rows against the existing teacher-query targets, cross-fitted as cross_fitting_design below.
row.endpoint: dense out-of-domain macro at int8/sqrt, closed-form tables only -- the same scalar D2's bar reads, so the preflight and the probe are commensurable.
row.comparator: R0's shipped table in the identical frame, plus the sum-init zero-residual compile as the exact floor.
row.bar: DIAGNOSTIC AND ROUTING, not an adoption -- no candidate may ship from a closed-form fit. NUMERIC AND FROZEN. Let S(T, j) be the dense out-of-domain macro at int8/sqrt of table T on OOD fold j, and let C be THE SINGLE SHARED COMPARATOR: arm (a)'s sum-init zero-residual compile (amended, BLOCKER 4 -- the row says 'the sum-init zero-residual compile', singular, and the additive arms do not possess one; scoring each arm against its own baseline would forgive the segmentation arms their compile discrepancy while holding the additive arms to exact R0). Fold gain g_arm,j = S(arm solved, j) - S(C, j); g_arm is the stitched out-of-fold gain. CLASS SELECTION, frozen: g_D2 = max(g_a, g_d); g_additive = max(g_b, g_c); g_best = max over all four; the WINNER is the arm attaining g_best on the stitched OOF macro, and that SAME arm supplies the fold signs and the fused read. AUTHORISE full D2 chains iff ALL of: (1) g_best >= 0.00519 (the chain bar itself, unrounded -- a screen routing a five-chain spend must clear the bar those chains will face; 0.0052 was its display rounding); (2) g_best > 0 in at least 4 of 5 folds, on that same winning arm; (3) dev token occurrence mass on zero-update rows <= 20%, computed over ALL row occurrences the arm produces on the FULL PINNED DEV SUITE, with incumbent rows counted zero-update by R0's own training `updates` array and new rows by whether any fit query activates them (MAJOR 11 -- restricting the denominator to new rows only would return ~0 by construction, since candidates are selected BY fit frequency); (4) the fused GAIN of the winning arm against C, read out-of-fold over the frozen convex0 w=0.8 operator's four components, is >= -0.0020 (a gain, not a raw macro: the raw fused macro is ~0.57 and the condition would be vacuous). A fused failure is a probe failure and does NOT license routing to another dense arm; (5) arm (a)'s sum-init compile reproduced R0 within 0.001 dense AND the ALGEBRAIC pooling canary passed. REVERSAL MARGIN, frozen: the additive class replaces D2 iff g_additive - g_D2 >= 0.0020 at equal added-row budget; between 0 and 0.0020 the tie breaks to ADDITIVE on the registered ground that an additive row with zero residual recovers R0 exactly while a segmentation change does not. MULTIPLICITY: four arms, one winner, reported with all four gains; no arm may be added after a number.
row.multiplicity: Four pre-named arms, one winner by the frozen margin above. No hypothesis test and no Holm family: nothing is adopted here and no bar is cleared. Every arm's cross-fitted gain is reported, including the losers, so the routing decision is auditable rather than asserted.
row.no_survivor: NO new-row class carries closed-form residual capacity. That is a strong and cheap argument against spending five chains on ANY of them, and it is the outcome that would make the compositional-capacity direction closable on evidence rather than on budget. It does not by itself fire the milestone exit -- see D2's exit_precondition.
row.why_closed_form_is_informative_here: Because M7 and M8 both already use closed-form distilled tables as a screening instrument that TRACKS the trained artifact: T1 ranked teachers on exactly this criterion, and B7's real-data run reproduced M7's trained dev macro (0.3439) at the argmax lambda. Its known failure mode is documented and guarded against: B17 fired a registered branch on a 957-query fit set and was DISOWNED because the same class scored 0.3439 on 350K queries. Hence the cross-fitting requirement and hence 'routing, never adoption'.
row.cost_estimate: Target under one hour for the closed-form half, MEASURED not assumed (G5); the OOF fused read adds one corpus pass over the frozen operator's four components. Tokenizer training measured at 50 s for 34,014 merges over 337,981 queries; scoring the OOD pair through the released path measured at ~1 s per table.
row.bar_frozen: 2026-08-29, before any tokenizer existed; RE-FROZEN the same day by amended_2, before any solve, any residual and any retrieval score existed.
row.plan_status: LIVE -- run this BEFORE D2's chains.
row.cross_fitting_design: AMENDED (BLOCKER 3). Five deterministic folds over the 337,981 TRAIN fit queries AND, independently, five balanced folds over each OOD component's query ids. Fold j fits the tokenizer, the feature dictionary and the rows on TRAIN folds != j and scores ONLY OOD fold j; the five held-out query-vector sets are stitched into one out-of-fold prediction set from which the primary macro is computed. No OOD query ever enters any fit. WHY: the first design scored every fold's table on the identical 1,915 dev queries, which makes the five gains fit-perturbation replicates that share ~80% of their data and score on the same set -- 'g > 0 in 4 of 5 folds' would then be nearly redundant with a positive mean rather than an independent condition. Exact-duplicate query texts are grouped so a duplicate cannot straddle folds, and the TRAIN/OOD text overlap is measured and reported.
row.frozen_definitions: FROZEN BEFORE ANY SOLVE OR SCORE (BLOCKERs 2/5, MAJORs 8/9/12/13/14). K = 35,014 added rows, identical in every arm, asserted exactly -- fewer than K unique candidates is a hard failure, not a silent continue. WORD n-grams n in {2,3}; CHARACTER n-grams n in {4,5} within lowercased whitespace words; both ranked by raw corpus occurrence frequency with ties broken by the feature itself so selection is order-independent; all features fire from the same post-prefix, post-special-token, post-truncation incumbent representation. ARM (d) COLDNESS: a row activated by FEWER THAN 20 fit queries is forced to zero residual -- 20 because this probe's own coverage contract already names the 0/<5/<20 bins, and because a literal 'zero updates' threshold makes arm (d) ALGEBRAICALLY IDENTICAL to arm (a) (a ridge column with no activations has normal equation lam*Delta = 0). LAMBDA: grid {1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1,10}; a fixed deterministic inner 90/10 split of each outer fold's fit half; tokenizer and feature dictionary fitted on the inner 90% and then held fixed; lambda chosen by mean cosine of the NORMALIZED predicted vector to the teacher target on the inner validation queries -- never on any retrieval score -- ties to the LARGER lambda; ridge then refit on the full outer fit with that frozen dictionary; selected independently per arm and per fold, with the whole cosine grid reported. RIDGE SCALE: every arm's bag rows are divided by R0's OWN per-query sqrt-count denominator, not by the arm's (MAJOR 7) -- the denominator cancels at serve time under L2 normalization but NOT inside the least-squares objective, so an arm-specific denominator would silently change each arm's residual target, per-query weighting and effective lambda. INT8 FRAME: the residual target and the sum init are built from the DEQUANTIZED shipped int8 incumbent rows; incumbent int8 codes and scales are preserved byte-for-byte and only the new block is quantized; folded token weights are not reapplied. LAMBDA SEARCH ORDER, amended 2026-08-29 before any full-scale lambda or retrieval number existed: the GRID IS UNCHANGED, but it is evaluated from the LARGEST lambda DOWNWARD and the descent stops once the inner-validation cosine has decreased at three consecutive evaluated points; evaluated and skipped values are both reported, with the CG iteration count and convergence flag for every solve, and maxiter is raised to 3000. WHY: the additive character n-gram arm's system is badly conditioned -- 12.6M non-zeros over 35,014 highly overlapping columns -- and one measured solve at lambda=1e-2 took 403 s at 1,051 CG iterations, so the full grid over four arms and five folds projects to 7-9 hours with the two smallest lambdas likely hitting maxiter WITHOUT CONVERGING, which would be a wrong number rather than a slow one. The rule is deterministic, is applied identically to every arm, and cannot change the selected lambda unless the validation curve is non-unimodal: it always evaluates at least the top four grid points and skips a smaller one only after three consecutive decreases. It is also retrieval-blind like the rest of the lambda rule, so it cannot select an endpoint. DISCLOSURE: the smoke's inner-validation cosine was MONOTONE INCREASING in lambda (0.788 at 1e-4 to 0.878 at 10 for the segmentation arm), which is what suggested the descent; that smoke ran at K=512 on 20,000 queries -- a different system from the frozen one -- and no full-scale lambda or retrieval number existed when this was written.
row.amended_2: 2026-08-29, after a second Codex adversarial review, of the IMPLEMENTATION design, before any solve or any retrieval score existed. Six BLOCKERs and eight MAJORs adopted; two of the BLOCKERs were contradictions inside this row, which implementation could not repair. BLOCKER 1: stage 1 made descriptive -- it gated on section 17b's slope as a one-directional bound, which the D2 row forbids, and could have killed the additive arms on a fertility test irrelevant to them. BLOCKER 2: arm (a) respecified as merges over the incumbent WordPiece stream with learned merge ranks. BLOCKER 3: cross-fitting rebuilt on disjoint OOD scoring folds. BLOCKER 4: one shared comparator C. BLOCKER 5: arm (d)'s coldness frozen at <20, without which it is arm (a). BLOCKER 6: the pooling canary made algebraic. MAJORs 7-14: common ridge denominator, K corrected to 35,014, the nested lambda rule, the OOF fused gain, condition (3)'s denominator, the frozen feature definitions, the int8 frame and the class-selection rules. DISCLOSURE: the stage-1 fertility number was measured in a prototype BEFORE this amendment -- OOD reduction 0.229 (programmers) / 0.245 (physics) at K = 34,014, against the ~0.104 the old text named. It CLEARS under both the old gating reading and the new descriptive one, so the amendment cannot have been chosen to change this probe's route; it is adopted because the gate was invalid, not because it bound.
row.amended_3: 2026-08-29, before any full-scale number: lambda SEARCH ORDER only (grid unchanged), on measured conditioning. See frozen_definitions.
